delta.state.empty_true_d: There is genuinely no record in this scope. Adjust scope or create one.
delta.state.empty_notcollected_d: Collection is not configured yet — the value is not zero, it has not started.
delta.state.empty_filter_d: Nothing matches the current filters. Loosen or clear filters.
delta.state.empty_permission_d: Your role lacks read permission under this Subject/Scope. Request access.
delta.state.error_d: Could not read data. Retry; if it persists, contact admin with the Trace ID.
delta.state.offline_d: Network/runtime connection lost. Showing the last confirmed local cache.
delta.state.blocked_d: Blocked by a permission/security boundary. Higher authorization or approval required.
delta.state.loading_d: Reading confirmed data along the evidence chain…
delta.state.updating_d: Showing the last confirmed version while fetching the newest values; it will replace automatically.
delta.state.partial_d: Only some sources returned. Missing parts are marked explicitly, never backfilled silently.
delta.state.stale_d: Data passed its freshness threshold. Treat conclusions as indicative; refresh or wait for update.
delta.state.degraded_d: Some capabilities are degraded. Core reads remain available; non-critical features may be limited.
delta.state.permission_denied_d: Your role cannot view this object. Request Subject/Scope authorization.
delta.action.prototype_notice: Prototype confirms interaction only; it never calls a backend. Codex wires real execution per the Action Contract.
